test_title: PYST 47: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows with 4 people each, in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.

In Row I - L, O, V and E are seated and all of them are facing south.

In Row II - P, I, C and T are seated and all of them are facing north.

C sits next to the person at the extreme left end of their row and is exactly opposite O. V sits at the extreme left end of their row and is exactly opposite T. E is the immediate neighbour of V and is exactly opposite P. Who sits at the extreme left end of the row of people facing North?
solution:
**Explanation:**

From the given information:

Step 1: C sits next to the person at the extreme left end of their row and is exactly opposite O. V sits at the extreme left end of their row and is exactly opposite T. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3c20107c58812506c72e25a86cc3d71224e93df2d8b85a09b181c4ea14e182a.png] 

V is facing south so extreme left will become extreme right.

Step 2: E is the immediate neighbour of V and is exactly opposite P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a38a03d1475db6528ac36ed78cf5871afcafe8b487c184743ff462da2e882e6.png] 

We place E next to V and P opposite to E and then place L and I at the only spots left.

From the arrangement, we can see that **I sit at the extreme left end of the row of people facing North.**

**Hence, the correct answer is option 3.**
